32770: The main character of the story, he chooses to attend a former all-girl school simply because it is close to his home. The first day at the school, he is forced to join the student council as its vice president and sole male representative.
32797: The student council president and a second-year student. She is serious, diligent, and talented in most subjects.
32798: Aria Shichijou is a second-year student (later a third-year student) who serves as the Student Council as Secretary and Shino Amakusa's best friend. She is the most mature character in appearance and comes from an affluent family.
32799: A first-year, sixteen-year-old genius return student. She's really the most mature of the characters, but she is very sensitive about her body, which still appears to be that of an elementary school student. She is the smartest student at Ousai Academy and boasts an IQ of 180.
32922: Ranko Hata is the head of the school's newspaper club. She likes to take photos of the student council members to sell around the school, usually without the permission of those being photographed, and she often gets caught.
32923: A member of the Disciplinary committee. She is afraid of men.
32924: A member from the judo club. She is the one who approached Tsuda to ask to create a judo club and is very passionate about judo. She has an innocent way of thinking. She listens to the student council president, Shino and it's shown that she also looks up to her.
32925: A teacher at Ōsai Academy, who happens to be the advisor of the student council. She, like Aria and Shino, often has perverted thoughts on her mind, and apparently has a thing for younger guys (and the male students of the school are often targeted by her).
32926: Takatoshi's younger sister, who is a third year in junior high school and plans to attend Ōsai like her brother.
32927: Aria's maid at home. She's good with cooking and cleaning, but can still be ditzy and unreliable as her master.
36954: She's a friend of Suzu. She's in the Robot Research Club and joined in order to make better vibrators.
42035: Kotomi Tsuda's first friend in school. She may look like a delinquent but she actually is a klutz.
74127: A tomboyish friend of Mutsumi who is one of the original founders of the Judo Club.
76866: The president of Eiryou High School's Student Council.
